decisions.reason: Excluding rejected clips from the monthly approved-clip quota does not change the task-local trial batch currently assigned under this Requirement.
The quota treatment of rejected clips does not change permitted source material, topic constraints, exclusions, or the trial batch source constraint.
Strict approval and quota exclusion reinforce compliance generally but do not change the existing white-text-only and no-text-effects standards.
The account is already designated for posting approved clips; treatment of rejected clips in the production quota does not alter account provisioning or purpose.
The source establishes consequences for clips that fail approval but does not modify the existing narrative-completeness or standalone-understandability criteria.
The source does not change the required clean visual style or prohibited treatments; it only defines quota treatment for clips below the overall quality standard.
Mention of moment-selection training does not modify the current requirement to select substantive, lesson-bearing moments.
Excluding rejected clips from the approved-output quota does not change which posted clips or performance metrics are tracked.
The general approval consequence does not alter the existing requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
The source does not change the established minimum or maximum clip duration.
The rejected-clip quota rule does not modify the existing hook-selection criterion or its scope.
